i_ipod.lore.common: Spins its click wheel so fast that you whizz straight past the song you wanted.

speaker.lore.epic: Was turned up for the street party and made every car alarm on the road join in with the chorus.
speaker.lore.legendary: Was left playing in a lost suitcase and led the airport staff straight to it by the sound of the drums.

x_atm_machine.lore.uncommon: Rolls out a paper receipt so long that it trails along the pavement.

x_battery.lore.uncommon: Lives in the kitchen drawer with fifty others, half of them flat and all of them pretending not to be.

x_cd_changer.lore.uncommon: Shuffles between five albums so often that the family argues about which one is on.

x_guitar_amp.lore.uncommon: Has a little red light that glows when it's warm and ready to roar.

x_karaoke_machine.lore.rare: Showed the lyrics so fast that everybody sang a different word at the same time.
x_karaoke_machine.lore.uncommon: Gives a round of fake applause after every song, even the terrible ones.

x_flashlight_battery.lore.uncommon: Rolls into the gap behind the sofa the moment the torch is opened.

x_tape_deck.lore.rare: Copied one tape onto another so many times that the last copy sounded like it was sung underwater.

x_wireless_charger.lore.legendary: Was left in a sunny window, charged a lost bee that landed on it, and the bee now visits every morning.

x_cassette_tape.lore.common: Gets its tape tangled in the car player, and the song comes out sounding underwater.

x_flashlight_torch.lore.rare: Shines its beam on the ceiling and turns a bedtime story into a shadow-puppet show.

x_light_stand.lore.common: Stands on three spindly legs and topples whenever a dog runs past.

x_vending_kiosk.lore.legendary: Gave out a free can every time a sad face looked into its glass, and the office became the happiest in town.
